bugs.title: [OVN] packet drops when provider network MTU exceeds tenant network MTU

blockers.summary: Regression mentioned: "…two commits in one to not introduce a regression by doing them separately. There were small changes required to unit tes…" (hudson-openstack)

The fix only takes effect when `ovn.ovn_emit_need_to_frag` is enabled, and it also depends on OVN support for `gateway_mtu`. Without the option the reported packet drops persist, and the discussion does not say whether it is the default or whether the SRU test plan must enable it.

The original patch introduced a regression (bug #2105383) in `_gen_router_port_options`. The stable backports deliberately combine the fix with its revert in a single commit. Any Ubuntu SRU must carry both together, or it will ship the regression.

Backports exist only for stable/2025.1, 2024.2 and 2024.1. No backport is shown for older series such as 2023.x or Yoga, so Ubuntu releases or Cloud Archive pockets that ship those versions have no upstream fix to pick up.
The thread contains no Ubuntu package upload, no test plan, and no verification of the fix in a real deployment. The upstream backports were checked only with unit and functional tests.

The 19.2.6-0ubuntu0.24.04.1 package in noble-proposed removes the `auth_supported` option and breaks libvirt RBD storage pools ("failed to set RADOS option: auth_supported"). A re-spun upload (.2) restoring the option is only in a personal PPA and has not been uploaded to noble-proposed or verified there.

The SRU team was asked to keep the update in noble-proposed until the libvirt bug LP #2172324 is resolved, and the bug carries block-proposed-noble. Dependency or Breaks handling between ceph and libvirt has not been addressed, so users could update one package and not the other.

19.2.6 contains the CephX CVE fix, which can cause authentication failures when upgrading to an unpatched 20.x. Policy requires the content to be present in resolute and stonking, so the 20.2.4 SRU (LP #2166817) must be released to them first, and that prerequisite is still pending.
The autopkgtest regression in libvirt on arm64 against the noble ceph upload is not shown to have been resolved or explained, and is likely related to the auth_supported removal.

The description's Test Case and Regression Potential sections are generic and do not describe the specific CephX/auth-key behaviour change, the auth_supported compatibility fix, or the upgrade implications. The changelog also does not mention the new auth_supported patch. Reviewers need concrete verification steps.

The tags show verification-done-noble together with block-proposed-noble. Verification was performed on the .1 package, which has the regression, and the .2 respin needs fresh verification. The caracal verification is still marked needed.

blockers.summary: A user reports the fix is incomplete on resolute. Once the engine has loaded a TPM key, libtss2-esys cannot create RSA keys in the same process (EVP_PKEY_fromdata_init returns -2, esys_crypto_ossl.c:728). Re-authentication then fails until wpa_supplicant is restarted. The patch may not fully resolve the wpa_supplicant use case, and the verification covers only the first connection.

There are two standing issues with these patches:
